environment: Node test runner, python3 branches.py from the slice commit, cli-runner scratch repos, stub-server gh shim and glab-stub, no network

cases.title: Github regex rule feature matches x/feature/{name}
cases.given: A scratch git repo made by cli-runner with a controlled HOME and PATH
cases.when: preflight pr with --format x/feature/{name}, gh shim returns regex rule "feature"
cases.then: every sample passes, exit 0, tree unchanged
cases.expected: every sample passes, exit 0, tree unchanged
cases.actual: every sample passes, exit 0, tree unchanged

cases.title: Rule ^feature/ fails the default format and passes feature/{name}
cases.given: A scratch git repo made by cli-runner with a controlled HOME and PATH
cases.when: preflight pr with default format, then feature/{name}, then x/feature/{name}
cases.then: default: exit 1 and slice sample fail; feature/: exit 0; x/feature/: exit 1 (anchored at start)
cases.expected: default: exit 1 and slice sample fail; feature/: exit 0; x/feature/: exit 1 (anchored at start)
cases.actual: default: exit 1 and slice sample fail; feature/: exit 0; x/feature/: exit 1 (anchored at start)

cases.title: Invalid or empty regex patterns do not crash the command
cases.given: A scratch git repo made by cli-runner with a controlled HOME and PATH
cases.when: rule patterns "(", "[", "*abc", "" through the gh shim
cases.then: exit 0..2, JSON on stdout, no Traceback, tree unchanged
cases.expected: exit 0..2, JSON on stdout, no Traceback, tree unchanged
cases.actual: exit 0..2, JSON on stdout, no Traceback, tree unchanged

cases.title: Gitlab reads exactly one call, api projects/:fullpath/push_rule
cases.given: A scratch git repo made by cli-runner with a controlled HOME and PATH
cases.when: preflight in pr and stack with glab stub returning branch_name_regex
cases.then: one recorded argv [api, projects/:fullpath/push_rule], no group path, one rule with source gitlab and label push rule
cases.expected: one recorded argv [api, projects/:fullpath/push_rule], no group path, one rule with source gitlab and label push rule
cases.actual: one recorded argv [api, projects/:fullpath/push_rule], no group path, one rule with source gitlab and label push rule

cases.title: Empty body and glab failure
cases.given: A scratch git repo made by cli-runner with a controlled HOME and PATH
cases.when: glab stub returns {} then exits 1 with boom
cases.then: empty body: no rules, one call; failure: no rules, note holds boom, all samples unchecked, one call
cases.expected: empty body: no rules, one call; failure: no rules, note holds boom, all samples unchecked, one call
cases.actual: empty body: no rules, one call; failure: no rules, note holds boom, all samples unchecked, one call

cases.title: Literal prefix with ticket key names the slice branch
cases.given: A scratch git repo made by cli-runner with a controlled HOME and PATH
cases.when: name slice S-001, S-002, S-027a, S-fix-3 and milestone M-1 with feature/PROJ-123-{name}; preflight pr; trailing slash variant
cases.then: feature/PROJ-123-S-001; preflight ok true, given true, slice sample feature/PROJ-123-S-001; trailing slash gives a JSON verdict, exit 0 or 2
cases.expected: feature/PROJ-123-S-001; preflight ok true, given true, slice sample feature/PROJ-123-S-001; trailing slash gives a JSON verdict, exit 0 or 2
cases.actual: feature/PROJ-123-S-001; preflight ok true, given true, slice sample feature/PROJ-123-S-001; trailing slash gives a JSON verdict, exit 0 or 2

cases.title: Format sdlc/{name}.. is refused with check-ref-format reason
cases.given: A scratch git repo made by cli-runner with a controlled HOME and PATH
cases.then: exit 2, one JSON line, ok false, error holds check-ref-format and not a valid branch name, tree unchanged
cases.expected: exit 2, one JSON line, ok false, error holds check-ref-format and not a valid branch name, tree unchanged
cases.actual: exit 2, one JSON line, ok false, error holds check-ref-format and not a valid branch name, tree unchanged

cases.title: Other invalid parts and hostile values are refused or handled without a crash
cases.given: A scratch git repo made by cli-runner with a controlled HOME and PATH
cases.when: formats with space, ~, :, trailing dot, .lock, leading dash, BEL, newline, ^, [, ?, //; corpus families flag-like-values, control-chars, injection
cases.then: invalid parts: exit 2 ok false; corpus values: JSON, no Traceback, exit 0..2, tree unchanged
cases.expected: invalid parts: exit 2 ok false; corpus values: JSON, no Traceback, exit 0..2, tree unchanged
cases.actual: invalid parts: exit 2 ok false; corpus values: JSON, no Traceback, exit 0..2, tree unchanged

cases.title: Format text is never run as a command
cases.given: A scratch git repo made by cli-runner with a controlled HOME and PATH
cases.when: formats with $(touch M), backticks and ;touch M; inside

cases.title: No format and no rules keeps default in four modes
cases.given: A scratch git repo made by cli-runner with a controlled HOME and PATH
cases.when: preflight in pr, stack, mr, direct on a repo with no config
cases.then: exit 0, ok true, format sdlc/{name}, derived false, given false, rules empty, samples pass or unchecked, state sample starts with sdlc/state-
cases.expected: exit 0, ok true, format sdlc/{name}, derived false, given false, rules empty, samples pass or unchecked, state sample starts with sdlc/state-
cases.actual: exit 0, ok true, format sdlc/{name}, derived false, given false, rules empty, samples pass or unchecked, state sample starts with sdlc/state-

cases.title: Empty GitHub list keeps default in four modes
cases.given: A scratch git repo made by cli-runner with a controlled HOME and PATH
cases.when: forge github, gh shim returns [] in each mode
cases.then: exit 0, ok true, default format, derived false, rules empty, samples pass or unchecked
cases.expected: exit 0, ok true, default format, derived false, rules empty, samples pass or unchecked
cases.actual: exit 0, ok true, default format, derived false, rules empty, samples pass or unchecked

attacks.result: no crash, no tree change, no command run
